title: Still Bill
studio_context: The Record Plant, Los Angeles, with the rhythm section that had left the Watts 103rd Street Rhythm Band; self-produced and spare. Lean on Me and Use Me, both top-two singles in 1972.

drum_performances.name: James Gadson
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The record that made his name: Use Me's cross-stick and kick trading 16ths under the hats, Kissing My Love's drum intro and half-swung 16ths, and a different groove, light and damped, on every track.

notable_moments.description: Use Me: the drum breaks, the rim and the kick alone under the hats, the hat opened on the off-beats at the end of each.
Kissing My Love: the record opens on the drums alone.
